## Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)

```

Summary

```{r}
bill_penguins <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(
    mean_bill_length = mean(bill_length_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(data = bill_penguins, mapping = aes(x = species, y = mean_bill_length)) +
  geom_col(fill = "red")
```
